description: This file contains shell functions related to Git operations, including creating commits, abbreviating OIDs, formatting git command outputs for stability, filtering, and testing reference outputs. It is used to automate and facilitate git-related tasks within a larger script or project.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates commits in a specified repository and assigns each commit's oid to a variable named after the commit, supplied as argument.

methods.name: get_abbrev_oid
methods.description: Generates an abbreviated form of a given git object ID (oid).

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats git command outputs into a human-readable and stable text by replacing commit IDs, quotes, and adjusting error messages.

methods.name: filter_out_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Filters the output of the previous formatting function using sed, based on provided options.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Prepares expected output files by formatting the input and saving it as 'expect'.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares git references with expected output after formatting and filters, optionally within a directory.
